profile.headline: Software Developer at IDEXX
profile.summary: I’m a developer who is a technoid, highly cognizant, life-long learner.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description: Skills: MySQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PHP · playwright

positions.title: Software Engineering Immersive Student
positions.description:
Three-month, 500-hour full-time and full-stack program conducted in a remote setting, providing experience with the latest front- and back-end programming languages, tools, and methodologies including: HTML, CSS, SASS, Javascript, jQuery, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AngularJS, NodeJS, ReactJS, Wordpress, Git, Github, and Agile/Scrum.

Developed a portfolio of individually and collaboratively focused in-class projects, including:

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: As the owner and sole employee of a small business I was required to take on all tasks. I worked as a receptionist, groomer, and accountant. During this time I learned a lot about Quickbooks and business operations.

positions.title: Lead Veterinary Nurse
positions.description: As the lead nurse of a newly formed clinic I was tasked with establishing pricing and forming guidelines for clinic procedures. In addition to all my nursing duties I maintained the computer systems and helped to structure the clinic network.

positions.title: Veterinary Assistant / Computer Technician
positions.description:
Perform medical tests in a laboratory environment for use in the treatment and diagnosis of diseases in animals. Prepare vaccines and serums for prevention of diseases. Prepare tissue samples, take blood 
samples, and execute laboratory tests, such as urinalysis and blood counts. Clean and sterilize instruments and materials and maintain equipment and machines. May assist a veterinarian during surgery.

In addition to my duties as a veterinary nurse I worked as an in-house computer technician. I was tasked with maintaining, updating, and integrating all computer systems, network, servers, printers, and website.

positions.title: Financial Services Consultant
positions.description:
- Process transactions and applications with the highest level of accuracy. 
- Operate various programs and devices. 
- Follow up on projects and member requests.

positions.title: Personal Shopper
positions.description:
- Processed customer orders while utilizing a proprietary computer device.
- Used problem solving skills to assure customer satisfaction.
- Quality control packaging and loading of orders.

positions.title: Computer Repair Technician
positions.description:
- Installed hardware and software into systems.
- Optimized system performance by various methodologies.
- Provided in home computer repair services.

positions.title: Guest Service Associate
positions.description:
- Front line customer service resolution and problem solving.
- Had to be knowledgeable of products in the store to direct customers.
- Daily data entry and answering multi-line phones.
